title: ROADMAP-REPLAY-X own invalidation counter is non-zero at baseline: unscoped product delta since the DUP-X pin
affected_invariant: roadmap invariant on historical evidence validity; ROADMAP-REPLAY-X counter historical_evidence_invalidated_by_later_changes == 0
impact: The stage accepted with 'current-HEAD revalidation' ships a gate that reports any undispositioned product change since a7d83925 as invalidation. git shows 275 changed files in intergrax/agents/applications, of which about 188 are not in the disposition SSOT (last extended at 01b3e196, 2026-11-10). The asserted counter (== 0) should fail at the baseline, so the closure claim is stale by its own rule. Code and git diff confirmed; the test itself was not executed.
recommendation: Parent to run the single git-only node test_replay_x_closure_counters_computed (E4). Then either extend the disposition SSOT through PDC-X/MCP-RC with qualification heads, or re-run ROADMAP-REPLAY-X at the integrated baseline and re-pin.

title: Tier-0 to Tier-3 import existed at the EBH-5/6/7, DUP-X and REPLAY-X certified pins; hard-boundary gates did not scan it
affected_invariant: intergrax/ MUST NOT import from applications/ (AGENTS.md hard boundary); FRZ-BND-03
impact: At every certified pin intergrax/cli/external_work.py imported applications.governed_contractor_application (function-local, plus importlib and sys.path injection). The CI script scan roots omit intergrax/cli and the EBH-6 BND gate checks contracts->runtime only, so 'no boundary violation' passed unproven. Removed 2026-11-08 (T-IGX-033-A, owner-known as HIST02-F-001/F-002); baseline grep finds no Tier-0 import of applications/agents. FRZ-BND-03 stays OPEN. Not a baseline defect; the historical PASS claims rested on a detector blind spot.
recommendation: Record that the EBH-5/6/7 boundary claims predate the fix and hold only from 8bfee643f; keep the new gate in the freeze selection; extend dynamic-import scanning from intergrax/cli to all of intergrax/; get the independent audit that T-IGX-033-A says is still to follow.

title: DIST-SCALE-X envelopes measured on queue/scheduler code that has since changed substantially; input flagged zero drift
impact: 14 files on the workload path changed (1749 insertions: task queue +427/-97, scheduler +383, new 567-line recurrence module, checkpoint store, colocated worker) after the physical runs; no re-measurement. Stage is operator-scoped and ENVELOPE_ONLY, so the exposure is stale capacity numbers, not a semantic breach. The mechanical A5 input showed 0 changes because cert_sha is a documentation pin with an empty surface; treat that as a tooling artefact.
recommendation: Mark envelopes as pre-D7 in the freeze packet, or re-run the P5/P6 physical batch at the integrated baseline. Fix the A5 surface derivation for doc-pin cert SHAs.

title: DUP-X duplicate-mechanism freedom not re-examined for 70 product modules added since the acceptance pin
